title: Logs

menu.popout: Open the architecture map in a new window

noProjects: Add or register a project first. Logs only collect records from registered project folders.

filters.redactionWarning: The secret masking rules aren't available, so original text may not be masked.
filters.unknownError: The server didn't accept this filter

first.title: No log sources are turned on yet
first.body: Turn on log sources to see and total other tools' session logs and this app's run history in one place.
first.privacy: Turning one on copies the contents of the source files into this app's index. Conversation text may be included, and values that look like secrets are masked before saving, but not perfectly. Original files are never changed.
first.noSources: No log sources are installed on this server. Ask the server administrator.

enable.title: Turn on a source
enable.body: Turn on a log source in settings

open.title: Open a session
open.body: Open a session from the list to play it back

empty.bBody: The sources that are on haven't read any events yet.
empty.hintD: To see session logs from other tools, turn on log sources in settings. ({titles})
empty.hintDMore: To see session logs from other tools, turn on log sources in settings. ({titles} and {rest} more)

sourceStatus.pending: {size} remaining — continues at the next collection
sourceStatus.pendingTip: This is the amount left over because of a single collection's budget. It isn't an error.
sourceStatus.noServerMessage: See the server log for details.
sourceStatus.scanBeforeHint: You can read it now with "Collect now"

detail.notFoundBody: It may be past the retention period or removed from the index.
detail.noEvents: This session has no events to show
detail.onlyHidden: No events to show; there are only events in hidden categories.
detail.noMatch: No events match (out of {n} up to the playback position)
detail.big: There are many events, so some features may be slow. Narrow down by category or lane.
detail.loadMoreNote: Only the first {n, number} events were loaded
detail.liveAction: Go to the end and refresh
detail.popoutNotice: The architecture map is open in a new window
detail.sameCall: Filter by events of the same call
detail.noteRedacted: Originals are read-only. The text on screen is an indexed copy with suspected secrets masked.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.emptyBody: Collect widgets to see usage by project, model, and agent at a glance.
dashboards.noSourcesNote: No log sources are on, so widgets may be empty
dashboards.widgetsEmpty: Add a widget or start from a template
dashboards.previewHint: The preview appears once the query is complete
dashboards.filterRangeNote: Only absolute times are saved for the period. Use the toolbar "Period" for relative periods.
dashboards.discardBody: Unsaved dashboard changes will be lost.
dashboards.deleteBody: Deleting removes all widget settings of this dashboard. You can undo it before saving.
dashboards.templateUnsavedBody: Applying a template adds to what you're editing now. Continue?

settings.title: Log sources
settings.description: Reads and indexes other tools' logs and this app's run history. Original files are only read, never changed. Server operation values such as the collection interval and retention period are set by the server administrator and can't be changed on this screen.

sources.empty: No log sources are installed on this server
sources.readOnlyTip: This app only opens and reads this source's original files. It never changes, moves, or deletes them.
sources.autoOnTip: This source's log folder exists on this computer, so it was turned on automatically. Turning it off saves that setting, and ↺ restores it.
sources.scanDirtyTip: Collects with the saved settings. Save first
sources.setupHelpNote: This app doesn't change external settings files (such as user-wide settings).
sources.confirmBody: This reads this source's files and copies the contents into this app's index. Conversation text may be included. Values that look like secrets are masked before saving, but not perfectly. Original files are never changed.
sources.redactOff: Masking of suspected secrets is off
sources.observeNote: To record hook and MCP calls while agents run, turn on the collector under "Observe" in the agent defaults
sources.unknownClassifier: The classifier can't be found, so collection is skipped

taxonomy.description: Set category names, descriptions, visibility, and colors. Category ids themselves come from sources and classifiers; what you can create here are display rules. Categories not in the list are shown by their id.
taxonomy.idInvalid: The id can't be empty, contain spaces, or exceed 64 characters
taxonomy.clearBody: This clears the classification in the settings and goes back to the defaults. Nothing reaches the server until you save.
taxonomy.emptyNote: The screen works even when the classification is completely empty. Categories are shown by their id.
taxonomy.empty: No category display rules. All categories are shown by their id.
taxonomy.missingNone: No categories are missing from the classification

runTab.title: Session logs
runTab.explain: Agent session logs of this run. Platform events are in the "Agents" tab.
runTab.emptyTitle: No session logs are linked to this run.
runTab.emptyBody: This run's agent sessions may not be collected yet, or the sources that read session logs may be off.

shortcuts.helpFind: Rows off screen can't be found with the browser's find (Ctrl+F) because of virtual scrolling. Use `/` search.

scanPartialMore: Some sources had errors ({title} and {rest} more)
